response.answer: For reliable performance prediction models, datasets should include diverse job types, nodes, runtimes, and telemetry frequency for CPU SLURM, GPU SLURM, and heterogeneous Kubernetes. Larger, varied datasets improve model accuracy.

results.content: # Artificial Intelligence & Deep Learning | 🤖 Primer • AI Agents • http://agents.aman.ai | Facebook. ## Artificial Intelligence & Deep Learning. Image 1: 🤖 Primer • AI Agents • http://agents.aman.ai. - AI agents are autonomous systems that combine the decision-making and action-oriented capabilities of autonomous frameworks with the natural language processing and comprehension strengths of LLMs. - The LLM serves as the “brain” within an agent, interpreting language, generating responses, and planning tasks, while the agent framework enables the execution of these tasks within a defined environment. - Together, they allow agents to engage in goal-oriented workflows, where LLMs contribute strategic insights, problem-solving, and adaptability to achieve outcomes with minimal human intervention. - Multi-Agent Framework for Enhanced Reflection. • Common Use-cases of LLM Agents. - LLM-Powered API Agent for Task Execution. AI agents are evolving fast. Platforms like SmythOS make it easy to build and deploy autonomous agents, combining LLMs with execution frameworks for efficient, goal-driven workflows.
